propositions: Per-unit Pandoc conversions invoke git root discovery redundantly: 884 real conversions spawned 1,770 total subprocesses (884 Pandoc + 886 root probes) instead of 887 (884 Pandoc + 3 cold probes).
_pandoc_timeout() calls load_config() on every _convert invocation, and load_config() invokes repo_root() before its result-cache lookup, causing repeated git rev-parse subprocesses.

Resolving timeout once per render pass and threading it through optional parameters preserves byte-equivalence, timeout fallback behavior, and all 884 real Pandoc assertions while reducing subprocess overhead to 883 redundant git-root calls eliminated.
A held-out three-unit oracle confirmed the fix: resolution count was RED at 3 per pass, GREEN at 1 per pass, and defect-seeded RED at 4 (leaked resolutions), then GREEN after restoration.

Paired before/after 884-unit traces measured 1,770 Popen calls (29.2378s) versus 887 Popen calls (29.0194s), confirming 883 eliminated subprocesses and 0.2184s savings on a quiet host without behavioral change to outputs or timeout handling.
